answer: 经计量实证检验，当在分析中同时加入受访者的种族特征与学术特征（ASVAB 认知能力复合得分及高中班级百分位排名）后，对获得学士学位（BA degree completion）的效应从正向显著的 0.3636 下降至 -0.2293 且转为统计不显著（p > 0.05）的目标变量是 **社会经济地位（SES / Socioeconomic Status）**。

payload.hypothesis: The effect of socioeconomic status (SES) on BA degree completion decreases from approximately 0.3636 to -0.2293 (and becomes statistically insignificant) when both race and academic characteristics (standardized ASVAB test scores and high school class percentile) are controlled for in the regression model.
payload.workflow: 1. Loaded and inspected nls_ses_processed.csv across all 8,773 rows. 2. Tested logistic, probit, and linear probability specifications across candidate predictors (SES, Sex, Family size). 3. Evaluated baseline specifications lacking academic characteristics against full specifications controlling for race, ASVAB composite scores, and high school class percentile. 4. Identified SES as the unique variable showing a coefficient drop from ~0.3636 to -0.2293 with loss of statistical significance.
